scope: Independent source review and independent rerun of implementation-author synthetic controls. No extension API call, candidate-code execution, or main-study heldout scientific artifact inspection by this reviewer.

synthetic_rerun.authorship: Implementation-author controls rerun and source-reviewed by a separate reviewer; these are not claimed as independently authored tests.

resolved_findings: Both measured Qwen development gates now determine every Qwen heldout permission and proposer permission; separate effective gate files preserve measured counts.
Warmup cache binds protocol, schema, exact request and raw-result hashes and revalidates terminal JSON; valid=true alone is insufficient.
Devstral and development-proposal reuse validates exact identity universes, duplicates, immutable assignment hashes and per-call/aggregate agreement before copying.
Protocol names H1/H2 and secondary RQ3 correctly; authorized readability edits do not alter experimental thresholds.
accepted_design: One separately registered schema-constrained Qwen configuration, unchanged scientific RQs/H1/H2 and original Holm family.
Exact fixed Devstral native and generated-development reuse plus all development proposal artifacts, including invalid/ineligible placeholders; no selection by outcome.
Separate new-request namespace and ledger; warmup contributes cost but no experimental observation.
Original finalizer and source freeze remain unchanged; extension assembly receipt separately binds new protocol, adapter/runner, reuse manifests, gates and cost lineage.
Every frozen assignment remains accounted, including gated, invalid, missing and budget-prevented cases.
limitations_and_required_reporting: Provider schema constraints can change substantive decisions. Version two is a distinct configuration, not correction of version-one outcomes.
Reused Devstral observations are not a new replication and cannot enlarge independent-task counts.

Source signoff does not establish provider schema support in practice, a successful technical gate, scientific effects, novelty or paper readiness; those require the logged warmup and completed artifact audit.
A separate result audit must check new and imported raw lineage, exact selections, assignment accounting, effective gates, both cost ledgers and statistical arithmetic.
The original public benchmark, source-overlap and helper-namespace exclusions remain unchanged limitations.
